beats.summary: Michael introduces a Yankee Swap gift exchange, changing the traditional Secret Santa.
Some office members express concern or disagreement about the gift exchange and the gifts.

beats.summary: Michael explains reverse psychology as a tool used during the game.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Reverse psychology is an awesome tool. I don't know if you guys know about it, but basically you make someone think the opposite of what you believe and that tricks them into doing something stupid.
